role: Exploratory development controls; no formal population read

selection.criterion: Two widening pairs with largest summed factor-group mean direct effect over all development inputs
selection.control_design: Twenty random sets with the same number of widening pairs in each layer; each pair is h,h+8
selection.role: Exploratory development nomination and testing; no independent confirmation

ablation_scope: Head outputs are set to zero. Unselected components are recomputed; embeddings, residual paths, and all MLPs remain active.
shuffled_source_scope: Uniform draws with replacement from the same ambient size and candidate mask, excluding the destination factor group.
